summary: A fresh venture gets no decision map from venture-work create, and score rank returns only counts, not the ranked entries
expected: Creating work on a venture without a map either drafts an initial map head or documents that expected_head stays null; `score rank` returns the snapshot's ranked entries so a cohort position can be reported without reading the database.
actual: Five `venture-work create` calls on v-fleet-controller succeeded with expected_head null and `decision-map show` still returned no map until an explicit revise; `score rank` output keys were id/ranked/excluded/cohort with integer counts. The cohort positions were read with a read-only SQLite query instead.
reproduction: Promote a new idea, run venture-work create, then decision-map show; run score rank --scorecard-id portfolio-reviewed-v1 --label X and inspect the JSON.
impact: Inconsistent map-head handling between new and existing ventures; ranking results cannot be reported from the CLI alone.
suggestion: Return ranked entries (idea_id, rank, score) from score rank; document or unify first-map creation.
